<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 400" width="500" height="400">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Axes -->
  <!-- y-axis -->
  <line x1="80" y1="330" x2="80" y2="60" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="80,50 76,62 84,62" fill="#000000" />
  
  <!-- x-axis -->
  <line x1="80" y1="330" x2="440" y2="330" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="450,330 438,326 438,334" fill="#000000" />

  <!-- Axis Labels (Times New Roman for math/science variables and general exam style) -->
  <text x="50" y="55" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-size="14" font-style="italic">Energy</text>
  <text x="430" y="355" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-size="14" font-style="italic">Reaction pathway</text>

  <!-- Energy Level Curves -->
  <!-- Reactants level line -->
  <line x1="100" y1="120" x2="160" y2="120" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="110" y="110" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-size="14">Reactants</text>

  <!-- Products level line -->
  <line x1="360" y1="270" x2="420" y2="270" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="375" y="295" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-size="14">Products</text>

  <!-- Curve without catalyst (higher peak) -->
  <!-- Starts at (160, 120), peaks at (260, 90), ends at (360, 270) -->
  <path d="M 160 120 Q 210 120, 260 90 Q 310 60, 360 270" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

  <!-- Curve with catalyst (lower peak, dashed or solid? Usually solid line with label, let's make it a distinct solid line) -->
  <!-- Starts at (160, 120), peaks at (260, 160), ends at (360, 270) -->
  <path d="M 160 120 Q 210 120, 260 150 Q 310 180, 360 270" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="6,4" />

  <!-- Labels for curves -->
  <text x="280" y="80" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-size="13">without catalyst</text>
  <line x1="260" y1="90" x2="275" y2="84" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />

  <text x="295" y="160" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-size="13">with catalyst</text>
  <line x1="285" y1="165" x2="295" y2="160" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />

  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="220" y="385" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 4.1</text>
</svg>

autoIssues: Part of the drawing touches the edge of the image, so something may be cut off.

issues: The catalyst curve is incorrectly drawn: a catalyst lowers the activation energy by providing an alternative reaction pathway with a lower peak, but the dashed line representing 'with catalyst' in this diagram goes monotonically downwards from reactants to products without any peak (activation energy) at all, which is chemically incorrect for a catalyst in a single-step reaction.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 550 420" width="550" height="420">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Axes -->
  <!-- y-axis -->
  <line x1="80" y1="350" x2="80" y2="50" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="80,40 76,52 84,52" fill="#000000" />
  
  <!-- x-axis -->
  <line x1="80" y1="350" x2="480" y2="350" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="490,350 478,346 478,354" fill="#000000" />

  <!-- Axis Labels -->
  <text x="65" y="45" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-size="15" font-style="italic">Energy</text>
  <text x="465" y="375" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-size="15" font-style="italic">Reaction pathway</text>

  <!-- Energy Level Lines -->
  <!-- Reactants level line -->
  <line x1="100" y1="120" x2="180" y2="120" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="115" y="105" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-size="15">Reactants</text>

  <!-- Products level line -->
  <line x1="380" y1="280" x2="460" y2="280" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="390" y="305" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-size="15">Products</text>

  <!-- Curve without catalyst (higher peak) -->
  <!-- Starts at (180, 120), peaks at (300, 75), ends at (380, 280) -->
  <path d="M 180 120 C 230 120, 260 75, 300 75 C 330 75, 340 200, 380 280" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

  <!-- Curve with catalyst (lower peak, dashed) -->
  <!-- Starts at (180, 120), peaks at (290, 130), ends at (380, 280) -->
  <path d="M 180 120 C 220 120, 250 130, 290 130 C 320 130, 340 210, 380 280" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="6,5" />

  <!-- Labels for curves -->
  <text x="310" y="62" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-size="14">without catalyst</text>
  <line x1="325" y1="67" x2="310" y2="73" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />

  <text x="305" y="155" font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-size="14">with catalyst</text>
  <line x1="300" y1="145" x2="285" y2="138" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />

  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="265" y="400" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 4.1</text>
</svg>
